behavior: While the popup of `Combobox` or `Autocomplete` is open, the rest of the page stays in the accessibility tree, also with `modal`. The combobox pattern of the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices hides no content. A screen reader user can read the page and can reach the trigger and the clear button. Base UI gives `aria-hidden` to each element outside the input group and the popup. Its way out for a touch screen reader is a hidden button with the fixed name "Dismiss".
